no_new_call_note: First week of the hunt, and the register opens empty. The week's dominant stories - the doubled long-dated debt buybacks, the crypto market-structure push, the metals run, the Hormuz supply squeeze - were already front-page news, so no idea built on them could be early. Nothing in the quieter corners was confirmed by more than one independent source, so nothing earned a written kill condition. An empty week is counted, not apologised for.
